_comment: Hayrli Pro. Fingerprint extracted from operhair_partner/android/app/hayrli-pro-release.jks (alias `hayrli-pro`, valid to 2053). Play App Signing is DISABLED for this app, so the upload key IS the verified signing key and this fingerprint is the one Android checks. If Play App Signing is ever enabled, add the Play-managed SHA-256 from Play Console -> Setup -> App integrity as an extra entry here. package_name must stay in sync with applicationId in android/app/build.gradle.kts (`flek.hayrli.pro`) - it previously read `flek.hayrli.pro.app`, which could never match.

Hayrli client — fingerprint extracted from /Users/user/keystores/hayrli-upload-keystore.jks (alias `upload`, CN=Hayrli, OU=Mobile, O=Flek). WARNING: if the app is enrolled in Play App Signing (default for new apps), the ACTUAL verified fingerprint is the Play-managed signing key, not this upload key. In that case add the Play App Signing SHA-256 from Play Console → Setup → App integrity as an extra entry in `sha256_cert_fingerprints`. Sideloaded / `flutter run --release` builds will verify with just this upload-key fingerprint.
